description: EPL insert-into populate-single-column-by-method-call parity replaying the single EPLInsertIntoPopulateSingleColByMethodCall execution (java-runtime-abe5e5cbda9667e7e112) across nine cases with one fresh runtime per case: the implicit rounds implicit-bean, implicit-map, implicit-oa, implicit-avro and implicit-json deploy '@name('s1') @public insert into {Prefix}_Stream select * from {origin}' then '@name('s2') @public insert into {Prefix}_Stream select com.espertech.esper.regressionlib.support.epl.SupportStaticMethodLib.{fn}(s0) from {eventType} as s0' — s1's listener is attached but stays silent because the sent event is the sibling type — while the configured rounds configured-map, configured-oa, configured-avro and configured-json deploy '@name('insert') insert into {target} select com.espertech.esper.regressionlib.support.epl.SupportStaticMethodLib.{fn}(s0) from {origin} as s0' then '@name('s0') select * from {target}'. Each SupportStaticMethodLib.convertEvent* UDF wraps the source event's 'two' property in pipe characters (convertEvent maps SupportMarketDataBean to a SupportBean carrying the symbol and intValue'd volume), and each round sends exactly one event observed through a listener record on the asserted statement (s2 implicit, s0 configured) plus value records pinning the underlying-kind assertions (Struct/Map/ObjectArray/Avro/JSON): implicit cases emit value(s1) and value(s2) at deploy time before the send's listener record, configured cases emit value(s0) after the send's listener record
